status: deferred_information_retention_gate_not_passed; not an adopted training or inference schema
anchor_rule: All primary observations are sampled at one pre-Path-publication anchor. Candidate Path is known before publication; future command, action, motion and labels are excluded.

candidate_fields.name: dem_history
candidate_fields.order: oldest to current; height then valid mask
candidate_fields.normalization: scalar reference-height offset only, then train-only valid-cell statistics
candidate_fields.missing: per-cell mask; unavailable frame blocks inference

candidate_fields.name: candidate_path
candidate_fields.order: future waypoint index then base x,y
candidate_fields.missing: waypoint validity mask; invalid Path blocks inference

candidate_fields.name: path_geometry_profile_coverage
candidate_fields.shape: 6 geometry scalars + 64 height samples + 64 coverage bits
candidate_fields.unit: mixed physical units; m profile; binary coverage
candidate_fields.timestamp: derived from anchor DEM and candidate Path
candidate_fields.normalization: physical geometry scales, train-only valid height statistics
candidate_fields.missing: coverage and field-availability masks; no inferred DEM values

candidate_fields.name: body_angular_velocity
candidate_fields.timestamp: anchor, synchronized with IMU and DEM

candidate_fields.name: flipper_position
candidate_fields.normalization: complete-only train statistics after verified physical zero/sign
candidate_fields.missing: per-joint mask; missing or stale blocks inference

candidate_fields.name: track_sprocket_velocity
candidate_fields.frame: URDF joint coordinates, forward robot-body mode
candidate_fields.normalization: mean(front,rear) after raw [-100,100] rad/s clip, scaled by 0.05; train-only statistics may follow only after gate
candidate_fields.missing: front/rear four-joint availability mask; no zero filling

candidate_fields.name: availability_domain_masks
candidate_fields.shape: one per critical field plus DEM/Path elements and domain

arm_condition: arm_configuration=fixed_stowed_pose; tolerance must be frozen prospectively; outside tolerance or unknown -> abstain
required_before_adoption: resolve candidate ranking and Outcome relationship divergence
